title: Data Anonymization Toolkit
summary: A config-driven pipeline that anonymises tabular data, generates statistically faithful synthetic data, and stress-tests the result with a 10-attack adversarial red team, producing a privacy-validated dataset and audit report for consulting engagements. It wraps SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer to power its multi-phase synthetic data generation module.
